initial_one_source_diagnostic_budget.note: Original full Dense generation also includes its own VAE/I2V encoding and decoding; do not count that as zero VAE cost. A2/A3 conditional on human observation. Additional source requires a separately bounded scope.

fixed_output_policy: Full 81-frame lossless RGB8 MKV and full review MP4
No thinning frames, resizing or automatic deletion
Separate original generated MP4 and VAE-only replay
True school file SHA and user review
storage_capacity: Request actual school storage budget; suggested >=2GiB for one-source A-layer videos but not allocated
first_run_blocker: A0 video cannot be reviewed until verified school MP4 exists; no claim of pre-existing S2 files.

latest_human_observation.implication: Stop treating severe fishscale as universal and preserve mild flicker as a separate control phenotype

primary_severe_case_gate.must_not_run: A1/A2/A3, B1, full 40-step or parameter sweep until human severe positive is identified unless a separate, explicitly authorized research scope is established
primary_severe_case_gate.first_action: Recover exact original image, prompt, seed, full inference recipe and output; run one school full Dense reproduction only after model/callback preflight and independent approval
primary_severe_case_gate.next_if_severe: Select existing school mild control and minimum crossed source/seed comparisons; then targeted A1/A2 videos
